articles.title: A Free, Star-Studded July 4th Concert Will Rock Philly for America's 250th
articles.summary: Christina Aguilera, Will Smith, and the Roots headline a massive free concert on Philadelphia's Benjamin Franklin Parkway this July 4th. The six-hour "One Philly" event marks America's 250th anniversary with fireworks at 11:45 p.m. Organizers aim for the largest free concert in the U.S.

articles.title: Democracies Are Falling Behind on Safe Drinking Water, MIT Study Finds
articles.summary: A new MIT study reveals a paradox: while democracies are slightly better at providing basic water access, they're losing ground to non-democracies on safe drinking water. The reason? Safe water is invisible, so politicians get less credit. About 2 billion people lack clean water access.

articles.title: The 6 Best Electric Pressure Washers to Blast Away Summer Grime
articles.summary: Electric pressure washers are now lighter, quieter, and nearly as powerful as gas models. Popular Mechanics tested top picks: the Greenworks 2700-PSI leads with high output and a steel-braided hose. Budget pick Sun Joe SPX3000 offers auto-shutoff and dual soap tanks for $170.
